_src.levels: FIGHTING_DESIGN.md section 10 table, verbatim: reaction delay to a VISIBLE startup (frames), block chance once reacted, guess weights on unreactable mixups (adapt), anti-air, punish a move <= -5 on block, punish route, throw tech (a guess), parry use, meter use, NERVE management, execution drop, aggression. L8 aggression 'adapts'.
_src.styles: [R] lane AI: plan weights per fighter cpu.style (plans.ts); boss_armor / boss_showman are the two boss plans (their fighters JSON styles), every other style name maps through kit.ts STYLE_ALIAS.
_src.levels_R: [R] lane AI additions (not in the research table): guard = chance the CPU holds a guard posture in neutral while inside the opponent's threat range (the only way ANY player blocks a move faster than their reaction); respect (optional, default 0 = off, no RNG roll) = chance per neutral decision to respect a PRESSER (rules.press) inside the range of the buttons it has been pressing: swing a longer normal into its walk-in or hold a guard instead of walking / dashing / pressing a slower button into it - on for the harness 'optimal' persona (0.9); a P4 lever for the levels (measured 2026-09-30, 10 seeds vs the masher persona: L4 4->5, L6 4->5, L8 7->6 wins, i.e. no clear gain, and it reshuffles level-vs-level RNG, so the levels ship with 0); thinkF = frames between neutral decisions; antiZone = extra share of reacted projectiles the CPU jumps over (on top of the style jumpProj) and its chance to dash in between projectiles; meter tier 'cancel' is kept for L7/L8 because the table's 'all' there follows L6's 'all + cancel supers'.
_src.rules: [R] whiffReactPct = whiff punishes need this % of the level's reaction delay after the whiff becomes visible (block punishes need none: the move was already blocked); parryShare = fraction of the block chance spent on a parry instead of a block, per parry tier; lv1Spend (P2) = chance per route that a CPU allowed Lv3 (meter tier 'all' or 'cancel') spends a Lv1 while it holds fewer than 3 bars (else it saves toward PRIME TIME; a Lv1 that kills is always taken); lv3Cash (P2) = chance a CPU holding 3 bars at a Lv3 meter tier punishes with its Lv3 when it reaches (the cheapest kill still comes first); counterImpactNerve = NERVE bars needed for a counter-IMPACT; avoidFrightNerve = below this many NERVE bars an 'avoid' CPU stops spending NERVE; press = the opponent counts as PRESSING when the share of its free ground frames inside its own fast-button zone that ended in an attack start (EMA, time constant windowF frames) is >= rate - then, inside the range its fast buttons cover, a CPU holds a guard with its level guard chance instead of walking / dashing / pressing a slower button into it (plans.ts respect rule).
_src.personas: CONTRACT 11 / FIGHTING_DESIGN 12 harness personas; novice = 400 ms (24 f) delayed inputs; optimal = fast human reactions (10 f, top of the KI 12-19 f band) with perfect execution, blocks what it can see, punishes everything punishable.
_src.boss: FIGHTING_DESIGN 10 rules: bosses get TOOLS (armor, counter moves, phases), never faster reactions than L8.
_src.habit: [R] lane AI P2 (CHANGED(AI) CONTRACT 23.10): weight 0..1 of the opponent's observed HABITS (core/ai/habits.ts, visible move starts committed only after the level's reaction delay) in the guesses no reaction can make at that level: guard posture in its range = (1 - habit) x the flat guard lever + habit x min(1, 2 x block) x its attack rate in range; crouch vs stand = blended with its share of lows vs overheads; throw tech + close-range throw escapes with its throw share; wake-up guard / reversal / counter reads with its meaty rate. L0-L5 (reactF 28-60 f) block ground attacks ONLY this way.
_src.ring3d: [R] lane AI3D (CHANGED(AI3D) CONTRACT 35.17): step = share of the reaction (block) chance spent on a SIDESTEP when a step started at the reaction frame still takes the CPU off the reacted attack / projectile (core/ai/ring3d.ts plays it in a sandbox from the visible situation; never vs homing moves - at the 18-60 f reaction delays this is mostly slow linear moves and projectiles at range, STEPTUNE 35.15); stepGuess = chance per neutral decision inside the opponent's range to sidestep as a READ (x 0.4 + 3 x habit x its LINEAR habit, x (1 - its homing habit)); circle = chance per neutral decision to circle-walk off the ring wall behind the CPU (and x 0.3 to circle the opponent onto its own wall from mid range); antiStep = chance to answer a visibly circle-walking opponent on the reaction clock, and (x its step habit x 2.5) a step-happy opponent in neutral, with a homing / fighter cpu.antiStep move that reaches. Personas stepper / circler: probe_personas G3 (35.17).
_src.uniques: [R] lane AI P2: per-tool rates of core/ai/uniques.ts (counter reacts / reads, teleport escapes / projectile answers / wake mixups, stance, evades, armor-step reads / approaches, ball re-kick / pickup, rekka continuation on block, install); reads are further scaled by the level habit weight and the observed habit.
